articles.summary: The USD/JPY pair climbs to two-week highs near 156.90 during the early Asian session on Wednesday. The stronger US jobs data provide some support to the US Dollar (USD) against the Japanese Yen (JPY). All eyes will be on the US Federal Reserve (Fed) interest rate decision later on Wednesday.

articles.author: Lallalit Srijandorn
articles.summary: China’s Consumer Price Index (CPI) rose 0.7% in November from a year ago after arriving at an increase of 0.2% in October, the National Bureau of Statistics of China reported on Wednesday. The market consensus was for 0.7% in the reported period.
